summary: Galmed Pharmaceuticals filed an amended share purchase agreement to acquire all outstanding share capital of Colospan. The revised terms replace $2M in stock with $800K additional cash, making aggregate cash consideration $3.3M at closing. Up to $2M in performance-based earnout tied to cumulative net sales revenues starting July 1, 2027, with no payments on first $5M, then 7% on $5-12M and 9% above $12M, capped at $2M, accelerating upon qualifying sale/licensing or equity financings ≥$17.5M post-closing. The acquisition closed on June 22, 2026. Watch for integration milestones and earnout triggers.
